name: ip-speaker-console
description: Web console and management interface for the IP speaker prototype

scripts.dev: concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
